thread:
Jordan (AE): FYI FalconNova asked for an exec bridge to unblock POC. Main asks: BYO-KMS with explicit no-key-access clause, a POC latency objective (P95 < 150ms) and a small commercial concession for the trial. Can we mobilize for Tues 9am PST?
Leah (SE): I can run demo and the latency tests. Note: we do not persist KV cache across host restarts; they called that out as a requirement. Need to set expectations.
Omar (Security): We have a BYO-KMS attestation template. We'll confirm rotation/roles language but can't attest to customer's KMS ops.
Hana (Legal): If they demand contractual key-custody guarantees, we need an addendum. I'll draft language: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood will not access or derive customer keys."
Jordan (AE): Copy of their asks: "1) Customer-managed keys with proof we never access keys; 2) P95 under 150ms during POC; 3) 20% POC credit up to $15k."
Dante (VP Sales): 20% cap sounds ok if we get conversion commitment thresholds. What's ARR if they convert?
Jordan (AE): ~$650k ARR expected for Dedicated in year 1.
Mira (CRO): Given ARR, we can approve a limited concession. Need exact cap, term, and approval flow. Who will run finance approval?
Dante (VP Sales): I'll pull Finance into the thread and ask for a 6-hour review.
Leah (SE): Action items: Leah/Raj to run a 30m load and produce P95 traces for the bridge demo.
Omar (Security): I'll upload the attestation and highlight sections. Link incoming.
Hana (Legal): Drafting addendum now, will share by EOD.

Jordan (AE): I'll wait for legal + finance confirmation then send customer invite. If anyone can't make Tuesday, flag now.
Mira (CRO): I'll join and frame the concession.
Dante (VP Sales): Finance pinged. Waiting on confirmation.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all. Closing loop  will circulate final invite after addendum & finance ok.
